mentions.name: Independent Vet
mentions.description: A website and app that helps pet parents find veterinary practices nearby, showing whether practices are locally owned or corporate/private-equity owned.
mentions.problem: Pet owners can't easily tell whether nearby veterinary practices are locally owned or acquired by private equity; the site came out of a bad experience with a dog at a recently PE-acquired practice.
mentions.audience: Pet parents looking for nearby veterinary practices
mentions.source_excerpt: Independent Vet - a website and app that helps pet parents find locally owned (and corporate/PE owned) veterinary practices nearby.

evidence.value: Independent Vet - a website and app that helps pet parents find locally owned (and corporate/PE owned) veterinary practices nearby.
